270: +/**
271: + * The one mapping between the Studio's message model and assistant-ui's.
272: + *
273: + * Kept in one place and pure, so the thread can be tested without a runtime and
274: + * the runtime can be swapped without touching the transcript. Anything the
275: + * conversion does not understand is dropped rather than rendered as raw JSON:
276: + * an unknown part must never reach the screen as machine text.
277: + */
278: +
279: +import type { ThreadMessage, ThreadMessageLike } from "@assistant-ui/react";
280: +
281: +import type { ChatAttachment, ChatMessage, ChatPart, StudioError } from "../types";
282: +import type { UiNode } from "../ui/protocol";
283: +
284: +/** The name our generated-surface parts travel under. */
285: +export const SURFACE_PART = "odi-surface";
286: +
287: +type LikePart = Exclude<ThreadMessageLike["content"], string>[number];
288: +
289: +const TOOL_RESULT: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {
290: +  ok: { status: "ok" },
291: +  error: { status: "error", isError: true },
292: +  declined: { status: "declined" },
293: +};
294: +
295: +function toPart(part: ChatPart): LikePart | null {
296: +  switch (part.kind) {
297: +    case "text":
298: +      return { type: "text", text: part.text };
299: +
300: +    case "reasoning":
301: +      return { type: "reasoning", text: part.text };
302: +
303: +    case "ui":
304: +      return { type: `data-${SURFACE_PART}` as const, id: part.id, data: part.node };
305: +
306: +    case "source":
307: +      return {
308: +        type: "source",
309: +        sourceType: "document",
310: +        id: part.id,
311: +        title: part.title,
312: +        mediaType: part.mediaType,
313: +        ...(part.filename ? { filename: part.filename } : {}),
314: +      };
315: +
316: +    case "tool": {
317: +      const approval = part.approval;
318: +      if (approval) {
319: +        // A pending write is a question, not a result: the runtime keeps the
320: +        // message in `requires-action` until the user answers.
321: +        return {
322: +          type: "tool-call",
323: +          toolCallId: part.id,
324: +          toolName: part.name,
325: +          args: {},
326: +          argsText: "{}",
327: +          approval: { id: approval.id, prompt: approval.prompt },
328: +        };
329: +      }
330: +      return {
331: +        type: "tool-call",
332: +        toolCallId: part.id,
333: +        toolName: part.name,
334: +        args: {},
335: +        argsText: "{}",
336: +        result: { ...(TOOL_RESULT[part.status] ?? {}), preview: part.preview ?? "" },
337: +        isError: part.status === "error",
338: +      };
339: +    }
340: +
341: +    default:
342: +      return null;
343: +  }
344: +}
345: +
346: +function attachmentParts(attachments: ChatAttachment[]) {
347: +  return attachments.map((attachment) => ({
348: +    id: attachment.id,
349: +    type: attachment.contentType.startsWith("image/") ? ("image" as const) : ("document" as const),
350: +    name: attachment.name,
351: +    contentType: attachment.contentType,
352: +    status: { type: "complete" as const },
353: +    content: [
354: +      {
355: +        type: "file" as const,
356: +        data: attachment.id,
357: +        mimeType: attachment.contentType,
358: +        filename: attachment.name,
359: +      },
360: +    ],
361: +  }));
362: +}
363: +
364: +/**
365: + * A Studio turn as the runtime renders it.
366: + *
367: + * `content` stays the concatenated prose so history replays byte-identically;
368: + * `parts` is what the thread shows.
369: + */
370: +export function toThreadMessageLike(message: ChatMessage): ThreadMessageLike {
371: +  if (message.role === "notice") {
372: +    return {
373: +      id: message.id,
374: +      role: "system",
375: +      content: [{ type: "text", text: message.content }],
376: +    };
377: +  }
378: +
379: +  const parts = (message.parts ?? []).flatMap((part) => {
380: +    const converted = toPart(part);
381: +    return converted ? [converted] : [];
382: +  });
383: +
384: +  const content: readonly LikePart[] =
385: +    parts.length > 0
386: +      ? parts
387: +      : message.content
388: +        ? [{ type: "text", text: message.content }]
389: +        : [];
390: +
391: +  const failed = message.error !== undefined;
392: +
393: +  return {
394: +    id: message.id,
395: +    role: message.role,
396: +    content,
397: +    ...(message.role === "user" && message.attachments?.length
398: +      ? { attachments: attachmentParts(message.attachments) }
399: +      : {}),
400: +    ...(failed
401: +      ? {
402: +          status: {
403: +            type: "incomplete" as const,
404: +            reason: "error" as const,
405: +            error: message.error as never,
406: +          },
407: +        }
408: +      : {}),
409: +    ...(failed || message.retryText
410: +      ? {
411: +          metadata: {
412: +            custom: {
413: +              ...(message.error ? { error: message.error } : {}),
414: +              ...(message.retryText ? { retryText: message.retryText } : {}),
415: +            },
416: +          },
417: +        }
418: +      : {}),
419: +  };
420: +}
421: +
422: +function readCustom(message: ThreadMessage): Record<string, unknown> {
423: +  return (message.metadata?.custom ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
424: +}
425: +
426: +/**
427: + * The inverse: a runtime message back in the Studio's own model.
428: + *
429: + * The runtime hands a branch switch back as the originals it was given, so this
430: + * is only needed when a message arrives from somewhere else — an import, or a
431: + * future remote thread.
432: + */
433: +export function toChatMessage(
434: +  message: ThreadMessage,
435: +  parentId: string | null = null,
436: +): ChatMessage {
437: +  const text = message.content
438: +    .filter((part) => part.type === "text")
439: +    .map((part) => (part as unknown as { text: string }).text)
440: +    .join("");
441: +
442: +  const custom = readCustom(message);
443: +  const parts: ChatPart[] = [];
444: +
445: +  for (const part of message.content) {
446: +    switch (part.type) {
447: +      case "text":
448: +        parts.push({ kind: "text", text: part.text });
449: +        break;
450: +
451: +      case "reasoning":
452: +        parts.push({ kind: "reasoning", text: part.text });
453: +        break;
454: +
455: +      case "source":
456: +        parts.push({
457: +          kind: "source",
458: +          id: part.id,
459: +          title: part.sourceType === "url" ? (part.title ?? part.url) : part.title,
460: +          mediaType: part.sourceType === "document" ? part.mediaType : "text/html",
461: +          ...(part.sourceType === "document" && part.filename
462: +            ? { filename: part.filename }
463: +            : {}),
464: +        });
465: +        break;
466: +
467: +      case "tool-call": {
468: +        const result = part.result as { status?: string; preview?: string } | undefined;
469: +        const approval = part.approval;
470: +        const awaiting = approval !== undefined && approval.approved === undefined && !part.result;
471: +        parts.push({
472: +          kind: "tool",
473: +          id: part.toolCallId,
474: +          name: part.toolName,
475: +          status: awaiting
476: +            ? "running"
477: +            : part.isError
478: +              ? "error"
479: +              : result?.status === "declined"
480: +                ? "declined"
481: +                : "ok",
482: +          ...(result?.preview ? { preview: result.preview } : {}),
483: +          ...(awaiting ? { approval: { id: approval.id, prompt: approval.prompt ?? "" } } : {}),
484: +        });
485: +        break;
486: +      }
487: +
488: +      case "data":
489: +        if (part.name === SURFACE_PART) {
490: +          parts.push({
491: +            kind: "ui",
492: +            id: part.id ?? `ui-${parts.length}`,
493: +            node: part.data as UiNode,
494: +          });
495: +        }
496: +        break;
497: +
498: +      default:
499: +        break;
500: +    }
501: +  }
502: +
503: +  const attachments: ChatAttachment[] | undefined = message.attachments?.length
504: +    ? message.attachments.map((attachment) => ({
505: +        id: attachment.id,
506: +        name: attachment.name,
507: +        contentType: attachment.contentType ?? "application/octet-stream",
508: +        size: 0,
509: +      }))
510: +    : undefined;
511: +
512: +  const role = message.role === "system" ? "notice" : message.role;
513: +
514: +  return {
515: +    id: message.id,
516: +    parentId,
517: +    role,
518: +    content: text,
519: +    ...(parts.length ? { parts } : {}),
520: +    ...(attachments ? { attachments } : {}),
